description: Guards git and forge commands run through the Bash tool (refuses tool attribution, bulk staging, hook-bypass flags, force-pushes to protected branches and staged secrets; asks before every commit, push and post), asks before a secret file is read and before the guard's own configuration is edited, and checks the commit that just landed. Rules and their ids live in rules/registry.json.
